items.criterion: A trial submission stores one row carrying the team slug derived from the team name, and the response returns the team site address built from that slug.
items.judgment: Submit the trial form and read the trials table for a single row whose team_slug is the lowercased, hyphen-joined team name.

items.criterion: Six simultaneous submissions of one team name leave exactly one trial row and one accepted response.
items.judgment: Fire six concurrent submissions of the same team name and count the accepted responses and the stored rows.

items.criterion: An uploaded image exists in the object store at the key the scheme produces from the route id and the digest of the bytes.
items.judgment: Upload bytes as an author and head the bucket at the computed key.

items.criterion: A draft route requested by a reader answers exactly as a slug that was never created.
items.judgment: Request a seeded draft slug and an unused slug from one reader session and compare both the status and the body.

items.criterion: A reader publishing a draft route is refused by the server and the stored route stays at draft.
items.judgment: Patch the seeded draft route from a reader session and read the routes table back.

items.criterion: The home route carries thirteen ordered sections and the measured hero copy.
items.judgment: Read the home route and count its sections, then find the pinned headline and the three action labels.

items.criterion: A comparative claim renders its source and its checked date beside the statement.
items.judgment: Read the seeded comparison route and confirm every claim carries both fields.

items.criterion: Every response the site serves carries the strict transport policy header and the nosniff content-type policy header.
items.judgment: Read a page response, an API response and the not found response and inspect the headers on each.

items.criterion: A sector route shows only the proof cards belonging to its own sector.
items.judgment: Read the seeded sector route and compare the sector on each proof card with the route sector.

items.criterion: The visual direction of the marketing site reads as considered and quiet, with one accent colour carrying every primary action.
items.judgment: Open the home route and a sector route and look for a single accent used on actions alone.
